import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])  # not used
    s = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ''
    out_max = 0
    in_max = 0
    count = 0
    i = 0
    inside = False
    length = len(s)
    while i < length:
        c = s[i]
        if not inside:
            if c == '(':
                inside = True
            elif c == '_' or c == ')':
                count = 0
                i += 1
            else:
                count = 0
                while i < length and s[i] != '_' and s[i] != ')' and s[i] != '(':
                    count += 1
                    i += 1
                if count > out_max:
                    out_max = count
                count = 0
                if i < length:
                    if s[i] == '(':
                        inside = True
                    else:
                        i += 1
        else:
            if c == ')':
                count = 0
                inside = False
            elif c == '_' or c == '(':
                count = 0
                i += 1
            else:
                in_max += 1
                while i < length and s[i] != '_' and s[i] != ')' and s[i] != '(':
                    i += 1
                count = 0
                if i < length:
                    if s[i] == ')':
                        inside = False
                    else:
                        i += 1
    if out_max < count:
        out_max = count
    print(f"{out_max} {in_max}", end='')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
